remarks: Discover your dream home bathed in natural light with an inviting open floor plan. Lovingly updated and maintained, this gem features a radiant living area leading to a modern kitchen, complete with a central island, sleek granite counters, and SS appliances. The expansive great room boasts a convenient secondary staircase to the upper level where you'll find polished hardwood floors, a chic powder room, and a cozy first-floor bedroom with deck access. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite awaits with a spa-like bathroom, private balcony, ample closet space, additional well-appointed bedrooms, bathrooms, laundry, and a comfy seating nook. Nestled near the vibrant heart of Stamford Downtown, this move-in-ready abode is perfect for festive celebrations. A true turn-key treasure, ready to be called home.
